_note: Keyed by 'event_type:service' or 'event_type:*' for wildcard. Actions: log_only | run_cleanup | escalate_elon.

auto_healed:*.note: Watchdog already restarted. Record and close.

service_restart:*.note: Watchdog already restarted. Record and close.

disk_warn:*.note: Flag in brief. ELON proposes cleanup if recurring.

code_broken:*.reason: Rapid-fail implies syntax/import error — needs code repair.

network_down:*.note: External dependency. Monitor for >30 min, then brief.

mode_change:system.note: GREEN/YELLOW handled by router rules. RED pages Commander directly.
